command:
set -eu; F="$HOME/.config/frankenstein/chatgpt-client.env"; echo ENV_KEYS; awk -F= '/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=/{print $1}' "$F" | grep -E 'FRANK_VOICE|BROKER|MACHINE|OWNER|PERSON' || true; set -a; . "$F"; set +a; URL=${FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_GABRIEL:-http://127.0.0.1:8765}; TOK=${FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_GABRIEL_TOKEN:-${FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN:-}}; test -n "$TOK"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,urllib.request
url=os.environ.get('FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_GABRIEL','http://127.0.0.1:8765').rstrip('/')
tok=os.environ.get('FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_GABRIEL_TOKEN') or os.environ.get('FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN')
def req(path,body=None):
 d=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(); r=urllib.request.Request(url+path,data=d,method='GET' if body is None else 'POST',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+tok,'Content-Type':'application/json'}); return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=2).read())
out={'health':req('/health')}
try: out['state']=req('/v1/state-snapshot',{'person':'gabriel'})
except Exception as e: out['state_error']=type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:200]
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
PY
